description.value: The Caboose is a private 1-bedroom cottage on Bowen Island, managed by the Bowen Island Concierge rental agency, offering ocean and mountain views alongside a fireplace and full kitchen. It holds a perfect 5.00-star rating across 7 reviews and is described by guests as spotless, private, and welcoming. Bowen Island itself is a small island community reachable by ferry from Horseshoe Bay, making this a scenic off-route option for touring cyclists exploring the lower Sunshine Coast corridor.

enrichment_extras.reasoning: The website confirms this is an active 1-bedroom vacation rental cottage on Bowen Island managed by Bowen Island Concierge, with a kitchen, Free WiFi, fireplace, and ocean/mountain views listed among its amenities. No bike-specific content (storage, procedures, e-bike charging, tools, pump, or bike wash) appears anywhere on the listing or subpages. Contact phone (+1 (604) 841-8541) and email are found on the contact subpage; neither appears in the OSM tags, so no cross-check is possible for phone. OSM community is tagged as 'Vancouver' but coordinates and all website content confirm the property is on Bowen Island.
